normal.desc: 【基礎文法】I ___ that new science documentary recently. It is fascinating.
normal.explain: 主詞 I 搭配 have，且句尾有 recently（最近），需使用現在完成式 (have + V-p.p.)，表示從過去到現在的經驗或剛完成的動作。

normal.desc: 【基礎文法】Mr. Lin ___ in the marketing department for five years.
normal.explain: 句子中有 for five years（持續五年），表示從過去一直持續到現在的狀態，因此使用現在完成式 has worked。

normal.desc: 【時態】___ you ___ the final editing of the video yet?
normal.explain: 句尾有 yet，常用於現在完成式的疑問句或否定句，結構為 Have/Has + 主詞 + V-p.p.，因此選 Have / finished。

normal.desc: 【基礎文法】The tech firm ___ a new smartwatch that tracks your daily steps.
normal.explain: 句子缺乏主要動詞，且主詞為單數 The tech firm，根據語意表示「已經推出」，使用現在完成式 has launched 最合理。

normal.desc: 【時態】We ___ the official confirmation from the client yet, so please wait.
normal.explain: 句尾的 yet 提示現在完成式，表示「目前還沒有收到」，結構為 have not + V-p.p.，因此選 have not received。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If you ___ the red button, the machine will shut down immediately.
normal.explain: 第一類條件句：If 條件子句用現在式代替未來式，主要子句用未來式 (will shut down)，主詞 you 搭配原形動詞 press。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If the weather ___ bad tomorrow, we will stay indoors and watch movies.
normal.explain: 第一類條件句中，If 子句即使表示未來發生的事，也必須使用現在式。主詞 the weather 為單數，故選 is。

normal.desc: 【條件句】We will give you a 10% discount if you ___ the premium plan today.
normal.explain: 此為第一類條件句，主要子句 (We will give...) 為未來式，if 子句須用現在式，主詞 you 搭配動詞 purchase。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If she ___ hard for the test, she will definitely get a high score.
normal.explain: 第一類條件句 If 子句用現在式，主詞 she 為第三人稱單數，動詞需加 s/es，因此選 studies。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If the traffic ___ heavy, I will take the subway instead of driving.
normal.explain: traffic 為不可數名詞，視為單數，第一類條件句的 If 子句需用現在式單數動詞 is。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The new museum ___ by a famous architect last year.
normal.explain: 主詞 museum 是被建造的，需用被動語態 (be + V-p.p.)。時間是 last year，所以用過去被動語態 was built。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】All the guest rooms in this hotel ___ perfectly every morning.
normal.explain: every morning 表示常態性動作，使用現在式。主詞 rooms 是複數且「被」打掃，需用現在被動語態 are cleaned。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】My wallet ___ while I was taking the bus to work.
normal.explain: 錢包是「被」偷，必須用被動語態，且動作發生在過去 (while I was taking...)，故選 was stolen。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The technical problem ___ by our IT team by tomorrow afternoon.
normal.explain: 時間點為 by tomorrow afternoon（明天下午之前），表示未來的動作，且問題是「被」解決，故選未來被動語態 will be solved。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】English ___ in many different countries around the world.
normal.explain: 這是一個陳述事實的句子，用現在式。英文是「被」說的，因此使用現在被動語態 is spoken。

normal.desc: 【字彙】A good marketing ___ is needed to attract more young customers to our store.
normal.explain: strategy 意思是「策略」，marketing strategy (行銷策略) 最符合語意。environment 是環境，commute 是通勤，destination 是目的地。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The company made a huge ___ this year because of the popular new phone.
normal.explain: profit 意思是「利潤、收益」。make a profit 意為獲利，符合句子「因為受歡迎的新手機而賺取巨大收益」的語意。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Many people from the suburbs have to ___ to the city center for work every day.
normal.explain: commute 意為「通勤」。從郊區通勤到市中心上班符合邏輯。invest 為投資，install 為安裝，recover 為恢復。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Paris is a very popular tourist ___ for people who love art and history.
normal.explain: destination 意為「目的地」，tourist destination 表示「旅遊勝地」，符合巴黎作為熱門旅遊城市的描述。

normal.desc: 【字彙】If you have a fever or a bad cough, those are common ___ of the flu.
normal.explain: symptoms 意思是「症狀」。發燒和嚴重咳嗽是流感的常見症狀。refunds 退款，profits 利潤，environments 環境。

normal.desc: 【字彙】We must reduce plastic waste to protect our natural ___.
normal.explain: environment 意為「環境」。保護自然環境 (natural environment) 是減少塑膠垃圾的目的。warranty 保固，strategy 策略，commute 通勤。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Air ___ is becoming a serious problem in big cities with too many cars.
normal.explain: pollution 意為「污染」。air pollution (空氣污染) 在汽車過多的大城市日益嚴重。

normal.desc: 【字彙】This television comes with a two-year ___, so you can get it fixed for free if it breaks.
normal.explain: warranty 意為「保固」。根據後文「如果壞了可以免費維修」，可知這裡需要填入保固。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The item was broken when I opened the box, so I asked the store for a full ___.
normal.explain: refund 意為「退款」。因為商品收到時已經損壞，所以要求全額退款 (full refund) 最為合理。

normal.desc: 【字彙】If your computer is too slow, you might need to ___ the memory.
normal.explain: upgrade 意為「升級」。電腦太慢可能需要升級記憶體。commute 通勤，recover 恢復，pollute 污染。

normal.desc:
【短文】Please find the meeting notes attached. The design team has updated the UI graphics. If you need any further changes, please let me know before Friday. 
Question: What has the design team done?
options: A. They have canceled the meeting.
B. They have sent the notes.
C. They have updated the graphics.
D. They have requested further changes.
normal.explain: 信件中提到「The design team has updated the UI graphics.」，因此答案為 C。其他皆非設計團隊已完成的動作。

normal.desc:
【短文】Your flight to Tokyo has been delayed by two hours due to heavy rain. We will provide a meal voucher if you wait at the gate. 
Question: Why is the flight delayed?
options: C. Because of an engine problem.
D. Because there are too many passengers.
normal.explain: 告示提到「due to heavy rain」(由於大雨)，這屬於不良天氣狀況 (bad weather)，故選 B。

normal.desc:
【短文】If you are not 100% satisfied with your purchase, you can return it within 30 days. The shipping fee for returns will be paid by the customer. 
Question: Who pays for the return shipping?
normal.explain: 短文中明確指出「The shipping fee for returns will be paid by the customer.」，也就是由顧客來支付退貨運費。

normal.desc:
【短文】Eating a balanced diet has improved my sleep quality. If you want to feel more energetic, you should consume more vegetables and whole grains. 
Question: What is one benefit of a balanced diet mentioned here?
normal.explain: 文章開頭提到「Eating a balanced diet has improved my sleep quality.」，意即均衡飲食改善了睡眠品質，故選 A。

normal.desc:
【短文】The software must be installed on your computer before you can use the editing tools. If the installation fails, please restart the system. 
Question: What should a user do if the software does not install correctly?
normal.explain: 文末提到「If the installation fails, please restart the system.」，因此若安裝失敗，使用者應重新啟動系統。

normal.desc:
【短文】The local library has been closed for repairs since last month. It will be opened to the public again on November 15th. 
Question: When will people be able to visit the library again?
normal.explain: 文中說明「It will be opened to the public again on November 15th.」，因此 11 月 15 日大眾可再次造訪。

normal.desc:
【短文】I have lived in London for three years. It is an amazing city, but if you do not like rainy days, you might feel a bit depressed here. 
Question: What might make someone feel depressed in London, according to the text?
options: C. Living there for three years
normal.explain: 作者提到「if you do not like rainy days, you might feel a bit depressed here」，意即下雨天可能會讓人感到有些憂鬱。

normal.desc:
【短文】Thank you for booking with Sunset Hotel. Your accommodation is confirmed. If you plan to arrive after 10 PM, please inform the front desk. 
Question: What should a guest do if they will arrive at 11 PM?
options: D. Go directly to their room.
normal.explain: 文中提到「If you plan to arrive after 10 PM, please inform the front desk.」，11 PM 晚於 10 PM，故需通知櫃檯。

normal.desc:
【短文】A new strategy has been developed to reduce plastic pollution in the ocean. The government will invest two million dollars in this project next year. 
Question: What is the goal of the new strategy?
options: A. To build a new ocean.
B. To invest in real estate.
normal.explain: 首句指出「A new strategy has been developed to reduce plastic pollution in the ocean.」，清楚說明目標是減少塑膠污染。

normal.desc: 【介系詞】She has been interested ___ web design since she was a university student.
normal.explain: be interested in 為固定用法，表示「對...感興趣」。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Have you booked the flight to New York? 
B: No, not yet. I will do it ___ I finish this important task.
normal.explain: B 表示還沒訂機票，並說「我一完成這個重要任務就會去訂」。「as soon as」意為「一...就...」，引導時間副詞子句，符合語意。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: What happens if the machine breaks during the first year? 
B: Do not worry. It ___ by our technicians for free.
normal.explain: A 詢問未來發生的狀況，B 的回答應為未來式。且機器是「被」修理，需用未來被動語態 will be repaired。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The doctor advised him to eat foods rich in ___ to stay healthy and strong.
normal.explain: nutrients 意為「營養素」。醫生建議多吃富含營養素的食物以保持健康。symptoms 症狀，warranties 保固，pollutants 污染物。

【被動語態】A lot of plastic waste ___ from the ocean every year.
normal.explain: 主詞 plastic waste（塑膠垃圾）與動詞 remove（清除）是被動關係，且句尾 every year 表示常態事實，應使用現在簡單式的被動語態，故選 (A)。(B) 是主動，(C) 是完成式主動，(D) 是現在分詞皆不符。

normal.desc: 【字彙】We should always ___ glass bottles and paper to save natural resources.
normal.explain: 句意為「我們應該總是回收玻璃瓶和紙張以節省自然資源」。(B) recycle 回收最符合文意。(A) 浪費，(C) 打破，(D) 丟棄，皆不合邏輯。

normal.desc: 【時態】The government ___ new rules for solar energy.
normal.explain: 本題測試現在完成式。單數主詞 The government 搭配 has + p.p. 表示近期已經完成的動作（已經宣布）。(A) 缺少 be 動詞，(B) 缺少 s，(D) 是被動語態，不合文法。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If we use less water daily, we ___ the natural environment.
normal.explain: 本題測試 If 第一類條件句。If 子句用現在簡單式 (use)，主要子句應搭配未來式 (will + 原形動詞)，表示未來會發生的結果。故選 (D)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The public park ___ by a group of local volunteers last weekend.
normal.explain: 主詞 The public park（公園）是被打掃的，且時間為 last weekend（上週末），故須使用過去簡單式的被動語態 was cleaned。選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The changing ___ has caused a lot of serious problems for farmers in the south.
normal.explain: 句意為「不斷改變的『氣候』給南方的農民帶來許多嚴重問題」。(B) climate 氣候最符合句意。(A) 習慣，(C) 營養，(D) 裝置，皆不合理。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: ___ you finished reading the article on global warming? 
B: Yes, I just read it this morning.
normal.explain: 問句中有過去分詞 finished，表示這是一個現在完成式的疑問句（Have you + p.p.?），詢問「是否已經完成某事」。故正確答案為 (C)。

normal.desc:
【短文】The city has built a new recycling center. If citizens bring their plastic bottles, they will get a small reward. 
Question: How can people get a reward?
options: A. By buying new plastic items.
B. By working at the center.
C. By cleaning the city streets.
normal.explain: 這是一篇關於環境政策的短文。根據「If citizens bring their plastic bottles, they will get a small reward.」可知，只要帶塑膠瓶來就能獲得獎勵。因此正確答案為 (D)。

normal.desc:
【短文】Solar energy is becoming more popular. A large solar farm was built in the desert last year. It has provided electricity to thousands of homes. 
Question: What has the solar farm done?
options: B. Brought rain to the desert.
C. Created new jobs for farmers.
normal.explain: 短文提到「It has provided electricity to thousands of homes.」（它已經提供電力給數千個家庭）。electricity 等同於 power，故選 (A)。

normal.desc:
【短文】We have decided to turn off the lights at night. If we do this, the office will save a lot of energy. 
Question: Why are they turning off the lights?
options: A. To fix a broken machine.
normal.explain: 短文指出「If we do this, the office will save a lot of energy.」（如果我們這麼做，辦公室將省下大量能源）。關燈的目的在於節省能源，故選 (B)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The new smartphone ___ by millions of people already.
normal.explain: 主詞 The new smartphone 為單數，且與動詞 use（使用）是被動關係。選項中只有 (C) is used 是正確的單數被動型態。

normal.desc: 【字彙】You can connect this small smart ___ to your television to watch videos.
normal.explain: 句意為「你可以將這個小型的智慧『裝置』連接到電視上觀看影片」。(D) device 裝置最符合語境。(A) 氣候，(B) 能源，(C) 電池，皆不符合。

normal.desc: 【時態】Our tech team ___ a useful application for language learning.
normal.explain: 單數主詞 Our tech team 應搭配第三人稱單數動詞。句意為「已經創造出一個好用的應用程式」，故選 (A) 現在完成式 has created。(D) 被動語態與語意相反。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If the battery dies, the screen ___ dark immediately.
normal.explain: 第一類條件句句型：If + 現代簡單式 (dies)，主要子句使用 未來式 (will + 原形動詞)。故選 (B) will go。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】All digital files ___ on a secure server to prevent any data loss.
normal.explain: 主詞 All digital files（所有數位檔案）為複數，與儲存 (store) 為被動關係，故應選 (C) are stored 表示常態事實的被動。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The best ___ of this new camera is its ability to take clear photos at night.
normal.explain: 句意為「這台新相機最棒的『特色』是能夠在夜間拍出清晰的照片」。(D) feature 特色/特徵 最為合適。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why is the website so slow? 
B: I think the system ___ by a computer virus.
normal.explain: 主詞 the system（系統）是被攻擊的，且表達「已經遭到攻擊」的狀態，必須用現在完成式的被動語態。故選 (A) has been attacked。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The weekly session ___ to Friday morning because the boss was busy.
normal.explain: 會議 (session) 是被移動的，且後半句時間為過去式 (was busy)，故應使用過去簡單式的被動語態，選 (A) was moved。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Many companies now allow ___ work, so people can work from their homes.
normal.explain: 句意為「許多公司現在允許『遠距』工作，所以人們可以在家上班」。(B) remote 遠距的/遙遠的 最符合句意。

normal.desc: 【時態】He ___ from home since the beginning of this year.
normal.explain: 句中有 since (自從...) 引導的時間副詞片語，主要子句應搭配現在完成式 (has + p.p.)，表示動作從過去持續到現在。故選 (C)。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If you need help with the task, I ___ you an email later.
normal.explain: If 第一類條件句：If 搭配現在簡單式 (need)，主要子句使用未來式 (will + 原形動詞)。故選 (D)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】Important company rules ___ on the information wall for everyone to see.
normal.explain: 主詞 rules（規則）是被張貼的，必須使用被動語態。(A) are posted 是唯一的被動語態選項。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Working in a quiet environment can increase your ___, allowing you to finish tasks faster.
normal.explain: 句意為「在安靜的環境工作能提升你的『生產力』，讓你能更快完成工作」。(B) productivity 最符合語意。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Have you met the new team member? 
B: No, I ___ him yet because I was on vacation.
normal.explain: 問句使用現在完成式 (Have you met...)，且句尾有 yet (尚未)，回答時也應搭配現在完成式的否定型態。故選 (C) have not seen。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】Fresh fruit and vegetables ___ in the local market every morning.
normal.explain: 主詞 fruit and vegetables（蔬果）與動詞 sell（販售）是被動關係，且句尾有 every morning 表示常態，故選 (C) are sold。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Good ___ is essential for children to grow up healthy and strong.
normal.explain: 句意為「良好的『營養』對孩子健康強壯地成長是必要的」。(D) nutrition 營養，最合乎句意。

normal.desc: 【時態】Scientists ___ a link between eating too much sugar and heart diseases.
normal.explain: 主詞 Scientists 為複數，句意表達「已經發現了關聯」。使用現在完成式主動語態 (have found) 最能強調此一研究成果與現在的關聯性。故選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If you eat too much fast food, you ___ weight quickly.
normal.explain: If 引導的第一類條件句，前面用現在簡單式 (eat)，後面主要子句要用未來式 (will + 原形動詞) 表示結果。故選 (B)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The new diet plan ___ by doctors for patients with high blood pressure.
normal.explain: 主詞 diet plan（飲食計畫）與 recommend（推薦）是被動關係，計畫「被推薦」，故選 (C) is recommended。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Drinking a glass of warm water every morning is a very good daily ___.
normal.explain: 句意為「每天早上喝一杯溫水是很好的日常『習慣』」。(D) habit 習慣，符合文意。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Has she recovered from the bad cold? 
B: Yes, she ___ a lot of rest over the weekend.
normal.explain: 針對問句 Has she recovered... (現在完成式) 的回答，以及表達對現在有影響的近期動作，應對應使用現在完成式 (has taken)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The old bridge ___ last year for safety reasons.
normal.explain: 主詞 bridge（橋樑）是被關閉的，且時間為 last year（去年），必須用過去簡單式的被動語態，選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The ___ transportation in this big city is very convenient and cheap.
normal.explain: 句意為「這座大城市的『大眾』運輸非常方便且便宜」。public transportation 為固定名詞組合，意即大眾運輸。

normal.desc: 【時態】The mayor ___ several new parks in the city center recently.
normal.explain: 句尾有 recently（最近），通常搭配現在完成式 (has/have + p.p.)，表示最近完成的動作，故選 (C)。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If you take the subway, you ___ the traffic jam on the road.
normal.explain: If 子句使用現在式 (take)，主要子句應使用未來式 (will avoid) 來表達條件帶來的結果。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】Street lights in this neighborhood ___ every evening at exactly six o'clock.
normal.explain: 主詞 Street lights（路燈）是被打開的，且 every evening 表示常態動作，故選現在簡單式的被動語態 (A)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The bus driver took a different ___ today because of the road construction.
normal.explain: 句意為「因為道路施工，公車司機今天走了不同的『路線』」。(B) route 路線，符合語意。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Have they finished repairing the road? 
B: No, the construction workers ___ there since Monday.
normal.explain: 句尾 since Monday（自從星期一）指示動作從過去一直延續到現在，必須使用現在完成式，故選 (C)。

normal.speak: If she takes the pills, she will recover soon.
options: A. 她已經康復了，所以不用吃藥。
B. 雖然她吃了藥，但沒有康復。
C. 如果她吃藥，她很快就會康復。
D. 她拒絕吃藥，所以好不了。
normal.explain: 原句：If she takes the pills, she will recover soon. 意思是「如果她吃藥，她很快就會康復。」

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
options: A. 你的預約被取消了。
B. 你的預約還沒有確認。
C. 你的預約已經過期了。
D. 你的預約已經被調整了。
normal.explain: 原句：Your appointment has been adjusted. 意思是「你的預約已經被調整了。」

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the item is faulty, it will be exchanged.
options: A. 如果物品有瑕疵，將會被更換。
B. 這件有瑕疵的物品已經被更換了。
C. 就算物品有瑕疵也不能更換。
D. 我們正在檢查物品是否有瑕疵。
normal.explain: 原句：If the item is faulty, it will be exchanged. 意思是「如果物品有瑕疵，將會被更換。」

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have apologized for the long delay.
options: A. 我們正在為延誤道歉。
B. 我們已經為漫長的延誤道過歉了。
C. 我們不打算為延誤道歉。
D. 延誤的原因已經被解釋了。
normal.explain: 原句：We have apologized for the long delay. 意思是「我們已經為漫長的延誤道過歉了。」

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Has the departure time been announced?
options: A. 起飛時間改變了嗎？
B. 起飛時間會被推遲嗎？
C. 起飛時間已經公布了嗎？
D. 你知道起飛時間嗎？
normal.explain: 原句：Has the departure time been announced? 意思是「起飛時間已經公布了嗎？」

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The treatment has been finished completely.
options: C. 治療將在明天進行。
D. 治療已經完全結束了。
normal.explain: 原句：The treatment has been finished completely. 意思是「治療已經完全結束了。」

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If you feel sick, we will go to the clinic.
options: A. 如果你覺得不舒服，我們會去診所。
B. 我們已經去過診所了。
C. 雖然你不舒服，但我們不去診所。
D. 診所裡有很多生病的人。
normal.explain: 原句：If you feel sick, we will go to the clinic. 意思是「如果你覺得不舒服，我們會去診所。」

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: They have examined all the potential risks.
options: A. 他們忽略了所有潛在風險。
B. 他們已經檢查了所有潛在風險。
C. 他們將會檢查所有潛在風險。
D. 他們找不到任何潛在風險。
normal.explain: 原句：They have examined all the potential risks. 意思是「他們已經檢查了所有潛在風險。」

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The announcement has just been made.
options: A. 公告將在稍後發布。
B. 公告還沒有準備好。
C. 公告剛剛已經發布了。
normal.explain: 原句：The announcement has just been made. 意思是「公告剛剛已經發布了。」

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Have you attended the online gathering yet?
options: A. Yes, I will attend it tomorrow.
B. No, the gathering was yesterday.
C. Yes, it is very far from here.
D. Not yet, I will join it in ten minutes.
normal.explain: 原句：Have you attended the online gathering yet? (你參加線上聚會了嗎？) (A) 我明天會參加。(B) 聚會是昨天。(C) 是的，這裡離那很遠。(D) 還沒，我十分鐘後加入。故選 (D)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If we miss the boarding time, what will happen?
options: A. We will have to wait for the next flight.
B. The boarding time is at six o'clock.
C. We have already missed the bus.
D. Yes, I missed the boarding time.
normal.explain: 原句：If we miss the boarding time, what will happen? (如果我們錯過登機時間，會發生什麼事？) (A) 我們將不得不等下一班航班。(B) 登機時間是六點。(C) 我們已經錯過公車了。(D) 是的，我錯過了。故選 (A)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Has your responsibility been explained clearly by the boss?
options: A. No, I am not responsible for the boss.
B. Yes, she has told me exactly what to do.
C. The boss will explain it tomorrow.
D. I have a lot of responsibilities.
normal.explain: 原句：Has your responsibility been explained clearly by the boss? (老闆有沒有清楚說明你的職責？) (A) 我不對老闆負責。(B) 有的，她準確地告訴了我該做什麼。(C) 老闆明天會解釋。(D) 我有很多責任。故選 (B)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If the item is damaged, can it be exchanged?
options: A. Yes, it was broken when I got it.
B. No, I don't want to exchange it.
C. Yes, you can exchange it within seven days.
D. The item is very expensive.
normal.explain: 原句：If the item is damaged, can it be exchanged? (如果物品損壞了，可以更換嗎？) (A) 它來的時候就壞了。(B) 我不想換。(C) 可以，您可以在七天內更換。(D) 物品很貴。故選 (C)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Has the new venue been selected for tomorrow?
options: A. Tomorrow is a good day.
B. The venue is very beautiful.
C. We will choose it next week.
D. Yes, we have picked a larger room.
normal.explain: 原句：Has the new venue been selected for tomorrow? (明天的新場地選好了嗎？) (A) 明天是個好日子。(B) 場地很美。(C) 我們下週會選。(D) 是的，我們挑了一間更大的房間。故選 (D)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If the surgery goes well, when will he wake up?
options: A. The doctor says he will wake up in an hour.
B. He has already woken up.
C. The surgery was very dangerous.
D. Yes, the surgery goes well.
normal.explain: 原句：If the surgery goes well, when will he wake up? (如果手術順利，他什麼時候會醒來？) (A) 醫生說他一小時後會醒。(B) 他已經醒了。(C) 手術很危險。(D) 是的，手術順利。故選 (A)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Has the compensation been paid to the injured worker?
options: A. He is a very hard worker.
B. Yes, the money was sent to his bank this morning.
C. The compensation will be paid next month.
D. No, he hasn't been injured.
normal.explain: 原句：Has the compensation been paid to the injured worker? (賠償金已經付給受傷的工人了嗎？) (A) 他是很認真的工人。(B) 是的，錢今天早上已經匯入他的銀行。(C) 賠償金下個月會付。(D) 他沒有受傷。故選 (B)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If I forget my passport, will I be stopped at security?
options: A. I have never forgotten my passport.
B. The security check is very fast.
C. Yes, you will not be allowed to fly.
D. Your passport is in your bag.
normal.explain: 原句：If I forget my passport, will I be stopped at security? (如果我忘記帶護照，會在安檢被攔下嗎？) (A) 我從未忘記帶護照。(B) 安檢很快。(C) 是的，你將不被允許登機。(D) 護照在你的包包裡。故選 (C)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Have the qualifications been checked by the HR team?
options: A. Yes, the HR team is checking.
B. The qualifications are very high.
C. No, I haven't checked the HR team.
D. Yes, they have reviewed all the details.
normal.explain: 原句：Have the qualifications been checked by the HR team? (人資團隊檢查過這些資格條件了嗎？) (A) 人資團隊正在檢查。(B) 資格要求很高。(C) 我沒檢查人資團隊。(D) 是的，他們已經審核過所有細節了。故選 (D)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If the terminal is changed, how will we know?
options: A. They will make an announcement over the speakers.
B. The terminal is very crowded today.
C. We have already changed the terminal.
D. Yes, the terminal has been changed.
normal.explain: 原句：If the terminal is changed, how will we know? (如果航廈更改了，我們怎麼會知道？) (A) 他們會透過廣播發布公告。(B) 今天航廈很擁擠。(C) 我們已經換航廈了。(D) 航廈已更改。故選 (A)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Has the appointment been made with the dentist?
options: A. The dentist is very busy.
B. Yes, I have booked a time for next Tuesday.
C. No, the appointment was yesterday.
D. I don't like going to the dentist.
normal.explain: 原句：Has the appointment been made with the dentist? (已經跟牙醫預約了嗎？) (A) 牙醫很忙。(B) 是的，我已經訂了下週二的時間。(C) 預約是昨天。(D) 我不喜歡看牙醫。故選 (B)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If the pain continues, will you visit the pharmacy?
options: A. The pharmacy is closed on Sundays.
B. Yes, I visited the pharmacy yesterday.
C. Yes, I will go there to get some painkillers.
D. The pain has stopped completely.
normal.explain: 原句：If the pain continues, will you visit the pharmacy? (如果疼痛持續，你會去藥局嗎？) (A) 藥局週日沒開。(B) 我昨天去了藥局。(C) 是的，我會去那裡拿一些止痛藥。(D) 疼痛已經完全停止了。故選 (C)。

normal.desc: 【時態】I ___ three online courses on digital marketing this year.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗現在完成式。句尾的 this year 搭配現在完成式，表示從過去到現在的經驗或已完成的動作，故選 (A)。選項 (B) 為過去進行式，(C) 為現在進行式，皆不符合語意。

normal.desc: 【時態】She ___ to five different countries in Europe to study their cultures.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗現在完成式。強調從過去到現在累積的經驗（已經去過五個國家），必須使用 have/has + 過去分詞，故選 (B)。

normal.desc: 【時態】We ___ a lot of progress in our fitness journey since January.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗現在完成式。關鍵字 since January (自從一月起) 表示動作從過去持續到現在，需搭配現在完成式 (have/has + V-en)，故選 (C)。

normal.desc: 【時態】They ___ enough money to buy a second-hand bicycle for commuting.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗現在完成式。表示到目前為止「已經存夠了錢」，影響現在可以買腳踏車的狀態，故選 (D) have saved。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If we clean the beach together, we ___ the sea turtles.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗第一類條件句。If 子句使用現在簡單式 (clean)，主要子句應使用未來式 (will + 原形動詞) 表示可能發生的結果，故選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If you visit Japan in spring, you ___ the beautiful cherry blossoms.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗第一類條件句。If 子句用現在式 (visit) 表達未來的條件，主要子句要用未來式表示結果，故選 (B) will see。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If the online lecture ___ too difficult, I will watch the video again.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗第一類條件句。在 If 條件子句中，必須以現在簡單式代替未來式，主詞 the online lecture 為單數，故選 (C) is。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】Many cheap clothes ___ in other countries to keep the prices low.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗被動語態。主詞 clothes (衣服) 無法自己「製造」，必須是被製造。現在簡單式的被動結構為 am/is/are + V-en，故選 (D)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The local sports center ___ by hundreds of young people every weekend.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗被動語態。運動中心 (sports center) 是被造訪的地方，加上句尾 every weekend 表常態，需用現在簡單式被動語態，故選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】Plastic bags ___ from supermarkets to reduce ocean waste.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗被動語態。主詞 Plastic bags (塑膠袋) 無法自己移除，必須是「被移除」。複數主詞搭配 are + V-en，故選 (B)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Eating dumplings during the Lunar New Year is a common ___ in Taiwan.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗名詞字彙。在農曆新年吃水餃是台灣常見的「傳統 (tradition)」。選項 (A) 習慣，通常指個人的小動作；選項 (B) 行為，皆不如 (C) 貼切。

normal.desc: 【字彙】If you want to build strong ___, you should eat enough protein.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗名詞字彙。攝取足夠的蛋白質是為了練出強壯的「肌肉 (muscles)」，故選 (D)。選項 (A) 骨頭，(B) 皮膚，(C) 血液，皆不符語意。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Buying these shoes at half price was a real ___ for me.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗名詞字彙。以半價買到鞋子，形容買到物超所值的「便宜貨、划算的交易」，英文為 bargain，故選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The professor gave an interesting ___ on modern history yesterday.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗名詞字彙。教授昨天給了一場關於現代史的有趣「講座、授課 (lecture)」，故選 (B)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Cutting down trees destroys the natural ___ of many wild animals.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗名詞字彙。砍伐樹木會破壞許多野生動物天然的「棲息地 (habitat)」，故選 (C)。選項 (A) 籠子，(B) 工廠，皆不符常理。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Please make sure you have all your ___ before leaving the train.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗名詞字彙。下火車前應該確認帶走所有的「行李 (luggage)」，故選 (D)。選項 (A) 傢俱，(B) 車輛，皆不合理。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If you ___ your own coffee, you will save a lot of cash every month.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗第一類條件句。If 條件子句須用現在簡單式代替未來式，主詞 you 搭配原形動詞 make，故選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If he ___ eating junk food, he will feel much better and healthier.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗第一類條件句。If 引導的條件子句中，主詞 he 為第三人稱單數，動詞需加 s 以現在式代替未來式，故選 (B) stops。

normal.desc: 【時態】Over the last few years, global temperatures ___ significantly due to greenhouse gases.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗現在完成式。片語 Over the last few years (在過去這幾年期間) 常用來搭配現在完成式，表示動作持續到現在，故選 (C) have risen。

normal.desc: 【時態】She is very excited because she ___ her final assignment for the coding class.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗現在完成式。前半句 She is 表示現在的狀態，原因是她「剛剛已經完成」了作業，動作的結果影響到現在，故選 (D) has finished。

normal.desc: 【時態】Since he moved to Italy, he ___ a lot about local art and architecture.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗現在完成式。Since 子句接過去式 (moved)，主要子句必須使用現在完成式，表示從那時起持續到現在的動作或經驗累積，故選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If you stretch your body after running, your legs ___ so sore the next day.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗第一類條件句。If 子句用現在式 stretch，表示真實可能發生的條件；主要子句應搭配未來式表示隔天 (the next day) 的結果，故選 (B) won't feel。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If we want to understand their customs, we ___ to talk to the local elders.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗第一類條件句。If 子句為現在簡單式 (want)，主要子句表達未來的需求與結果，使用未來式 will need，故選 (C)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The new language courses ___ by the university to help international students.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗被動語態。課程 (courses) 不會自己提供，而是「被提供」，需使用 be 動詞加上過去分詞，故選 (D) are offered。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】Several endangered animals ___ in the national park by special guards.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗被動語態。動物 (animals) 是「被」守衛保護的對象。複數主詞需搭配 are + protected，故選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】A 20% extra charge ___ to your bill if you dine at that fancy restaurant.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗被動語態與條件句。額外費用 (charge) 是「被加」到帳單上的，單數主詞搭配 is + added，故選 (B)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Our yoga ___ told us to focus on our breathing during the difficult poses.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗名詞字彙。在瑜珈課中，指導我們呼吸的應該是瑜珈「指導教練 (instructor)」，故選 (C)。選項 (A) 隊長，(B) 牙醫，(D) 工程師，皆不合理。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The art museum is hosting a special ___ of paintings from the 19th century.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗名詞字彙。美術館舉辦的通常是畫作的「展覽 (exhibition)」，故選 (D)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】We went on a trip to Africa because we wanted to see the amazing ___.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗名詞字彙。去非洲旅行主要是為了觀賞令人驚嘆的「野生動植物 (wildlife)」，故選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【對話】A: Have you found a cheap flight to Paris yet? B: Yes, but if I book it today, I ___ a lot of money.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗第一類條件句。B 的回答中，If 子句用現在式 (book)，表示未來可能發生的狀況，主要子句要用未來式表達結果，故選 (B) will save。

normal.desc: 【短文】The cultural festival celebrates traditional music and dance. It has become very popular over the years. If you buy tickets online, you will avoid the long waiting lines at the entrance. Question: How can a visitor avoid waiting in long lines?
options: A. By arriving very early in the morning
B. By watching the dances on television
C. By purchasing the tickets on the internet
D. By bringing a traditional instrument

boss.desc:
【短文】A new study reveals that commuting for more than one hour daily has been linked to higher stress levels. Researchers suggest that companies offer flexible work hours. 
Question: What is the main finding of the study?
options: A. Commuting is cheap in the city.
B. Long commutes can increase stress.
C. Flexible hours cause lower productivity.
D. Researchers prefer to commute by train.
boss.explain: 文中指出「commuting for more than one hour daily has been linked to higher stress levels」(每天通勤超過一小時與較高壓力有關)，因此 B 是主要發現。

boss.desc:
【短文】To receive a full refund, the item must be returned in its original packaging within 14 days of purchase. Items that have been used or damaged will not be accepted. 
Question: Under what condition will a return NOT be accepted?
options: A. If it is returned within 7 days.
B. If it is in the original packaging.
C. If the item has been damaged.
D. If the customer asks for a refund.
boss.explain: 文中最後一句「Items that have been used or damaged will not be accepted.」明確指出損壞的物品不接受退貨，故選 C。

boss.desc: 【字彙】Our team has been trying to find a better ___ to solve this complex engineering problem.
boss.explain: solution 意為「解決方案」，與後面的 solve this problem 呼應。destination 目的地，refund 退款，accommodation 住宿。

boss.desc:

Question: What is a benefit of the annual membership?
options: A. Free coffee at the museum cafe.
C. You can host your own exhibition.
boss.explain: 文中提到「If you purchase an annual membership, you will be invited to all private gallery events」，意即能受邀參加私人展館活動。

boss.desc: 【綜合句型】The new environmental laws ___ by the government to reduce carbon emissions across the country.
boss.explain: 主詞 laws (法律) 是被引入的，需要被動語態，且搭配 recently 通常用現在完成式，故選 have been introduced 的現在完成被動式。

boss.desc: 【片語字彙】The CEO decided to ___ the new strategy instead of sticking to the old business model.
boss.explain: go ahead with 意為「推進、開始執行」。句意為執行新策略以取代舊模式。look forward to 期待，rely on 依賴，stay away from 遠離。

boss.desc:
【短文】Scientists have successfully developed a solar panel that works at night. This invention will significantly change how we use renewable energy. 
Question: What can be inferred about the new solar panel?
options: A. It requires a lot of water to work.
B. It only works when the sun is shining.
C. It generates power even when it is dark.
D. It is too expensive for most people.
boss.explain: 文章說「works at night」(在晚上運作)，這代表即使天黑也能產生能源，故選 C。infer(推論)的考法要求根據內文合理延伸。

boss.desc: 【時態】The financial report ___ to the investors by the time they arrive for the annual meeting tomorrow.
boss.explain: by the time 加上未來的時間點，常搭配未來完成式。報告是「被」寄出，需使用未來完成被動式 will have been sent。雖然難度稍微偏高，但為 B1 上層至 B2 的進階挑戰。

boss.desc:
【短文】As a loyal customer, you have been selected for a free upgrade to our premium internet service. If you accept this offer, your monthly speed will double without any extra charges. 
Question: What will happen if the customer accepts the offer?
options: A. They will have to pay double the price.
B. They will lose their internet connection.
C. Their internet speed will increase by 100%.
D. Their contract will be canceled.
boss.explain: 文中的「your monthly speed will double (速度將翻倍)」意思等同於速度增加 100%，故選 C。且沒有額外收費。

boss.desc: 【字彙】If you are experiencing severe ___, you should consult a medical professional immediately.
boss.explain: severe symptoms 意為「嚴重的症狀」。若經歷嚴重症狀應立即就醫。solutions 解決方案，nutrients 營養素，environments 環境。

【短文】A smart ring was introduced by a tech company last month. It can track your heart rate and sleep patterns. 
Question: What can the smart ring do?
boss.explain: 短文中提到它能「track your heart rate and sleep patterns (追蹤心率與睡眠模式)」，這些皆屬於健康數據 (health data)，故選 (C)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Traditional books are still loved by many. However, digital reading has become more common because tablets are easy to carry. 
Question: Why is reading on tablets common?
options: A. They are cheaper than books.
B. They are better for the eyes.
boss.explain: 短文提到平板閱讀變得普遍是因為「tablets are easy to carry (容易攜帶)」，portable 就是易於攜帶之意，故選 (D)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Remote work has changed our daily routines. If we do not commute, we will have more time to spend with our family. 
Question: What is an advantage of not commuting?
boss.explain: 短文提到「If we do not commute, we will have more time to spend with our family (如果不通勤，我們會有更多時間陪家人)」，故選 (D)。

boss.desc:
【短文】The office layout was redesigned by a famous studio. They added more open spaces so people can talk to each other easily. 
Question: Why did they add open spaces?
options: C. To make the office look larger.
boss.explain: 短文說明增加開放空間是為了「so people can talk to each other easily (讓人們容易交談)」，即鼓勵溝通 (encourage communication)，選 (A)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Your primary task this week is to organize the customer files. If you finish early, please help the design team. 
Question: What should the person do if they complete their work early?
boss.explain: 文中指示「If you finish early, please help the design team (若提早完成，請協助設計團隊)」，Assist the designers 意思與此相符，選 (B)。

boss.desc:
【短文】A recent study shows that walking for thirty minutes a day improves heart health. If you exercise regularly, you will feel less tired. 
Question: How long should one walk daily according to the study?
boss.explain: 短文指出需要走路 thirty minutes (30分鐘)。Half an hour 即為半小時（30分鐘），故選 (B)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Green tea is known for its health benefits. It is consumed by millions of people in Asia to help digestion. 
Question: Why do many people drink green tea?
boss.explain: 文中提到「consumed ... to help digestion (飲用以幫助消化)」，assist with digestion 為同義替換，選 (C)。

boss.desc:
【短文】To lose weight, you must burn more calories than you eat. This can be achieved by doing sports like running or swimming. 
Question: How can someone lose weight?
options: D. By using more energy than they consume.
boss.explain: 文中提到必須「burn more calories than you eat (消耗的卡路里要比吃進去的多)」，這等於 using more energy than they consume，故選 (D)。

boss.desc:
【短文】The city has introduced electric buses to reduce air pollution. If more people use them, the air quality will improve significantly. 
Question: What is the purpose of the electric buses?
options: C. To make the air cleaner.
boss.explain: 引進電動公車是為了解決「air pollution (空氣污染)」並改善空氣品質，這與 To make the air cleaner 意義相同，故選 (C)。

boss.desc:
【短文】A new bicycle lane was built near the river. It allows people to ride safely without worrying about cars. 
Question: What is true about the new bicycle lane?
options: A. It keeps riders away from cars.
B. It is only for walking.
C. It is located near the mountain.
D. It was built five years ago.
boss.explain: 短文指出新車道讓騎士「without worrying about cars (不用擔心汽車)」，意即可以避開車輛 (keeps riders away from cars)，選 (A)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Traffic congestion is a major issue during rush hours. The government plans to build another subway line to solve this. 
Question: How will the government handle the heavy traffic?
options: B. By constructing a new train system.
boss.explain: 文中政府的解決方案是「build another subway line (建造另一條地鐵線)」，這與 constructing a new train system 意思一致，選 (B)。

boss.desc: 請唸出：如果預算被批准，我們將開始下一個階段。

boss.desc: 請唸出：這是我人生中做過最困難的決定。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Have you ever bought a faulty item online?
options: A. I buy things online all the time.
B. The product is not faulty.
C. Yes, I will buy it online.
D. Yes, I once received a broken cup.
boss.explain: 原句：Have you ever bought a faulty item online? (你曾在網路上買過有瑕疵的物品嗎？) (A) 我經常上網買東西。(B) 產品沒有瑕疵。(C) 是的，我會上網買。(D) 是的，我有一次收到破掉的杯子。故選 (D)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If they change the topic, what will we talk about?
options: A. We will just follow their new direction.
B. The topic is very interesting.
C. They haven't changed the topic.
D. Yes, we will talk about the topic.
boss.explain: 原句：If they change the topic, what will we talk about? (如果他們改變主題，我們將談論什麼？) (A) 我們就跟隨他們的新方向。(B) 這主題很有趣。(C) 他們還沒改主題。(D) 是的，我們會談論這主題。故選 (A)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Has the background check been finished by the company?
options: A. The company has a good background.
B. Not yet, they are still checking my history.
C. Yes, the background check will finish soon.
D. I have finished the company check.
boss.explain: 原句：Has the background check been finished by the company? (公司完成背景調查了嗎？) (A) 公司背景良好。(B) 還沒，他們還在查我的經歷。(C) 背景調查很快會完成。(D) 我已經完成公司調查。故選 (B)。

boss.desc: 【時態】He ___ any new clothes since he started his minimalist lifestyle last year.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗現在完成式的否定型態。關鍵字 since (自從) 接過去時間，表示從去年開始直到現在都「沒有買」新衣服，必須使用現在完成式，故選 (B)。

boss.desc: 【條件句】The ocean will become more polluted if we ___ the use of plastic bottles.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗第一類條件句。主要子句使用未來式 (will become)，If 條件子句應使用現在簡單式代替未來式。依照語意「如果我們不減少使用塑膠瓶」，故選 (C) don't reduce。

boss.desc: 【被動語態】All the final essays must ___ by Friday evening, or the teacher will not grade them.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗助動詞的被動語態。主詞為 essays (論文)，無法自己完成動作，必須被完成。助動詞 must 後面接原形動詞 be 加上過去分詞 (V-en)，故選 (D) be finished。

boss.desc: 【字彙】Finding cheap ___ in this popular tourist city can be very difficult during the summer.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗名詞字彙。在旅遊熱門城市，夏天要找到便宜的「住宿 (accommodation)」是很困難的。選項 (B) 溝通，(C) 對話，(D) 展覽，皆不符句意。

boss.desc: 【字彙】The government has started a new ___ project to protect the rare birds in the mountains.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗名詞字彙。為了保護稀有鳥類，政府啟動了新的「保育 (conservation)」計畫。注意不要與選項 (A) conversation (對話) 混淆。

boss.desc: 【短文】To encourage eco-friendly shopping, the grocery store is offering a special promotion. If you bring your own reusable bags, a small amount of money is deducted from your total bill. Many shoppers have praised this clever idea. Question: How does the store reward eco-friendly shoppers?
options: A. By giving them free reusable bags
B. By praising them on social media
C. By taking a little money off their bill
D. By offering them free groceries
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗短文推論。文中提到 money is deducted from your total bill (從帳單中扣除一小筆錢)，與選項 (C) taking a little money off their bill 意義完全相同。

boss.desc: 【短文】A fitness tracker is worn on the wrist to monitor physical activity. It counts your steps and estimates the calories you have burned. If you connect it to your phone, you will see a detailed chart of your daily progress. Question: How can a user view a detailed chart of their progress?
options: A. By pressing the button on the tracker
B. By visiting the doctor every day
C. By counting their steps carefully
D. By linking the device to a smartphone
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗短文細節。文章說明 If you connect it to your phone, you will see a detailed chart (如果連接手機，就可以看到詳細圖表)，link the device (連結裝置) 即為 connect 的同義改寫，故選 (D)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Distance learning allows you to study from anywhere in the world. However, it requires a lot of self-discipline. If you do not plan your schedule well, you will easily fall behind in your classes. Question: What is a disadvantage of distance learning mentioned in the text?
options: A. It is easy to fall behind if you are not organized.
B. It costs a lot more than regular classes.
C. The teachers are usually very strict.
D. You have to travel a lot to take exams.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗主旨推論。文中指出遠距教學需要自律，如果不妥善規劃時間就會落後 (fall behind)，選項 (A) 中 not organized (沒有組織/規劃) 完美對應文意。

boss.desc: 【短文】In Spain, taking a short nap after lunch, known as a siesta, was once very common. Today, modern work schedules have changed this habit. Most businesses in big cities are no longer closed in the afternoon. Question: What has changed about the siesta in modern Spain?
options: A. It has become popular all over the world.
B. It is less common because of modern work hours.
C. It is only practiced by people in big cities.
D. It has been completely forbidden by the law.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗短文推論。文中提到現代的上班時間改變了午睡習慣，多數大城市商家下午不再關門，這代表午睡習慣因為工作時間變得較不普及，故選 (B)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Coral reefs are often called the rainforests of the sea because they are home to thousands of species. Sadly, they are threatened by warming waters. If the temperature rises further, many corals will die. Question: Why are coral reefs compared to rainforests?
options: A. Because they need a lot of fresh rain
B. Because they are located near the equator
C. Because they support a wide variety of life
D. Because they have green plants growing on them
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗推論理解。文章首句提到珊瑚礁被稱為海中的雨林，是因為 they are home to thousands of species (是成千上萬物種的家)，表示其生態豐富度高，與選項 (C) support a wide variety of life 意思相符。

boss.desc: 【短文】Buying items in bulk can seem like a great way to save cash. However, if you buy too much fresh food, it might go bad before you can eat it. You should only buy dry goods like rice and pasta in large quantities. Question: What is the text's advice on buying things in bulk?
options: A. Always buy fresh food in large amounts.
B. Stop buying bulk items to save space.
C. Only buy things that are on sale today.
D. Limit bulk purchases to dry foods that last longer.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗短文主旨。文章建議生鮮食品買太多會壞掉，所以應該只大量購買米和義大利麵等乾貨。選項 (D) 限制大量購買僅限於保存較久的乾貨，最符合文意。

boss.desc: 【短文】Language barriers can be challenging when you travel alone. A simple translation app on your phone can solve most communication problems. If you learn a few basic greetings, the locals will be very friendly to you. Question: How should a traveler make a good impression on locals?
options: A. By learning some simple local greetings
B. By traveling with a large group of people
C. By buying them a new smartphone
D. By speaking English very slowly
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗短文細節。文章提到 If you learn a few basic greetings, the locals will be very friendly (如果你學幾句基本的問候語，當地人會對你很友善)，故選 (A)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Adults returning to education often worry about their ability to learn new things. Research shows that older brains are actually better at connecting different ideas. If you take your time, you will find that learning is a lifelong joy. Question: What advantage do older learners have according to research?
options: A. They learn to use new computers much faster.
B. They are better at linking various concepts together.
C. They do not need to study as much as young people.
D. They have more free time to attend classes.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗短文細節。文中提到 older brains are actually better at connecting different ideas (較年長的大腦其實更擅長連結不同的想法)，connecting ideas 的同義改寫即為 linking concepts，故選 (B)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The final score has been confirmed by the referee.

boss.explain: 原句為「裁判已經確認了最終比分。」（The final score has been confirmed by the referee.）。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If you are absent from the exam, you will get a zero.
options: A. 如果你在考試中作弊，你將會被當掉
B. 如果你沒有準備考試，你會考得很差
C. 如果你缺席考試，你將會得到零分
D. 如果你考試遲到，你將無法進入教室
boss.explain: 原句為「如果你缺席考試，你將會得到零分。」（If you are absent from the exam, you will get a zero.）。absent 意為缺席。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Has the weather forecast predicted snow for tomorrow?
options: A. Yes, they said it will snow heavily.
B. The dog is playing outside.
C. I need to wash my car.
D. The book is very thick.
boss.explain: 原句為「天氣預報預測明天會下雪嗎？」選項 A「是的，他們說會下大雪」為最佳回應。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the hotel loses our reservation, where will we stay?
options: A. We can try the hostel across the street.
C. The airplane is flying high.
boss.explain: 原句為「如果飯店弄丟了我們的預訂，我們要住哪裡？」選項 A「我們可以試試對面的青年旅館」最符合情境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The neighborhood has been improved a lot.
options: A. 鄰居變得非常友善
B. 鄰近的社區已經改善了許多
C. 附近的公園已經建好了
D. 這條街道變得非常吵雜
boss.explain: 原句為「鄰近的社區已經改善了許多。」（The neighborhood has been improved a lot.）。neighborhood 指鄰近地區或社區。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the athletes practice hard, they will win the cup.
options: A. 如果運動員受傷，他們將無法參賽
B. 如果運動員努力練習，他們將會贏得獎盃
C. 如果教練生氣，球員會感到緊張
D. 如果天氣不好，比賽將會延期
boss.explain: 原句為「如果運動員努力練習，他們將會贏得獎盃。」（If the athletes practice hard, they will win the cup.）。

boss.desc: 請唸出：如果你不符合要求，你將不會被接受。
boss.ans: IF YOU DO NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENT YOU WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED

boss.desc: 請唸出：延誤的原因尚未被調查。
boss.ans: THE CAUSE OF THE DELAY HAS NOT BEEN INVESTIGATED YET
boss.speak: the cause of the delay has not been investigated yet

boss.desc: 請唸出：如果你有保險，你將獲得賠償。
boss.ans: IF YOU HAVE INSURANCE YOU WILL GET COMPENSATION
boss.speak: if you have insurance you will get compensation

boss.desc: 請唸出：替代方案已經為緊急情況建立好了。
boss.ans: THE ALTERNATIVE PLAN HAS BEEN CREATED FOR THE EMERGENCY
boss.speak: the alternative plan has been created for the emergency

boss.desc: 請唸出：如果你有耐心，你會看到結果。
boss.ans: IF YOU ARE PATIENT YOU WILL SEE THE RESULTS
boss.speak: if you are patient you will see the results

boss.desc: 請唸出：營養已成為許多人關注的主要焦點。
boss.ans: NUTRITION HAS BECOME A MAJOR FOCUS FOR MANY PEOPLE
boss.speak: nutrition has become a major focus for many people

boss.desc: 請唸出：重點已在幻燈片上被強調。

boss.speak: the key points have been highlighted on the slide

填空題：S T _ E N _ T _ (優勢)
填空題：P _ O G _ E S _ (進步)

【短文】社群媒體與網路安全
options: A. They do not use the internet often.
C. They talk to strangers online.
D. They buy things on dangerous websites.
boss.explain: 此題考細節理解。短文中提到 Many users have had their personal data stolen because they used simple passwords（因為使用簡單的密碼，導致個資被盜），故選 (B)。

boss.desc: 【短文】城市規劃與交通
options: C. Stopped cars from entering some streets.
boss.explain: 此題考細節理解。文中提到 the mayor has closed several streets to cars（市長已禁止汽車進入幾條街道），即 (C) 所描述的行動，其餘選項文中未提及。

boss.desc: 【短文】工作與生活平衡
options: A. You will earn more money.
B. You can go home earlier.
C. You will meet new friends.
D. It helps you focus better.
boss.explain: 此題考細節理解。題目問規律休息的優點，短文提到 a good balance between work and rest makes people more focused（工作與休息的良好平衡讓人更專注），對應選項 (D)。

boss.desc: 【短文】傳統節慶與習俗
options: A. To remember a historical person.
B. To welcome the summer season.
C. To pray for a good harvest.
boss.explain: 此題考主旨與細節。文中首句提到 The Dragon Boat Festival is celebrated to remember a famous ancient poet（慶祝端午節是為了紀念一位著名的古代詩人），古人即為歷史人物，故選 (A)。

boss.desc: 【短文】志工與社會服務
options: A. Cook lunch for the community.
B. Paint walls and clean a garden.
C. Teach children how to paint.
D. Collect money for the center.
boss.explain: 此題考細節理解。短文明確指出 We need help to paint the walls and clean the garden（我們需要幫忙粉刷牆壁和清理花園），故志工的任務是 (B)。

boss.desc: 【綜合句型】網路安全
boss.explain: 此題考被動語態與時態。A new update（一項新更新）是被加入平台的，且時間是 last night（昨晚），故需填入過去簡單被動語態 (C) was added。

boss.desc: 【短文】城市交通
options: A. By asking a police officer.
B. By returning it to a subway station.
C. By riding it only on weekends.
D. By using a registered card for less than 30 minutes.
boss.explain: 此題考推論與細節。文中提到 If you use a registered card, the first thirty minutes are completely free（如果使用註冊過的卡片，前 30 分鐘完全免費），故選 (D)。

boss.desc: 【綜合句型】工作與生活平衡
boss.explain: 此題考被動語態。主詞 emails（電子郵件）是被寄出的，且描述現在開始實施的新規定（Now），因此使用現在簡單式的被動語態 are sent，選 (A)。

boss.desc: 【短文】節慶習俗
options: B. Outside their houses and temples.
C. Only in the night markets.
D. In the center of the street.
boss.explain: 此題考細節理解。短文中寫到 Tables are set up outside homes and temples（桌子被擺放在家門外和寺廟外），因此人們把食物放在 (B)。

boss.desc: 【綜合句型】社會服務
boss.explain: 此題考現在完成被動語態。由 Since（自從）引導的子句可知，主要子句需用現在完成式；而狗和貓是被領養的，所以使用 (C) have been adopted。

boss.desc: 【短文】網路安全與健康
options: A. The child will sleep too much.
B. The tablet will break easily.
C. The child will forget how to read.
D. The eyes will become dry and tired.
boss.explain: 此題考細節。文中提到 If a child looks at a screen for too long, their eyes will become dry and tired（看螢幕太久眼睛會乾澀疲勞），直接對應選項 (D)。

boss.desc: 【短文】交通建設
options: A. To the airport and business district.
boss.explain: 此題考細節。文中指出 It will connect the airport directly to the business district（它將把機場直接連接到商業區），因此地鐵會開往 (A)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The interest rate has been lowered by the central bank.
options: A. The bank is not open on Sundays.
B. Does that mean our loan will be cheaper?
C. I have not checked my balance yet.
D. Central park is a great place to visit.
boss.explain: 英文原句：The interest rate has been lowered by the central bank. 意思：中央銀行已經調降了利率。選項 (B)「那表示我們的貸款會變便宜嗎？」最符合邏輯。（現在完成式被動語態）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If you lose your debit card, the account will be frozen.
options: A. I will report it immediately if it happens.
B. The weather has been freezing lately.
C. My account has a lot of money in it.
D. I have never used an ATM before.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If you lose your debit card, the account will be frozen. 意思：如果你弄丟了簽帳金融卡，帳戶將會被凍結。選項 (A)「如果發生這種事，我會立刻掛失」最適合。（If 第一類條件句與被動語態）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the roof is not fixed, we will move out.
options: A. We can move the furniture later.
B. I will call the worker right now.
C. The roof looks beautiful in this color.
D. Moving to a new city is exciting.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the roof is not fixed, we will move out. 意思：如果屋頂不修好，我們就要搬走。選項 (B)「我現在就打給工人」最適合。（If 第一類條件句與被動語態）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If you break the rules, you will lose your deposit.
options: A. I promise I will follow all the rules.
B. The bank deposit has been made.
C. The rules are not written down clearly.
D. I have already lost my keys.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If you break the rules, you will lose your deposit. 意思：如果你破壞規定，你將會失去你的押金。選項 (A)「我保證我會遵守所有規定」最適合。（If 第一類條件句）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the heater is broken, it must be repaired today.
options: A. I have broken a glass by accident.
B. It is too hot to turn on the heater.
C. The repairman said he would come at noon.
D. I will buy a new pair of shoes.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the heater is broken, it must be repaired today. 意思：如果暖氣壞了，今天就必須修理。選項 (C)「修理工說他中午會來」最適合。（If 第一類條件句與被動語態）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Have the wrong shoes been returned to the store?
options: A. Yes, my sister took them back yesterday.
B. No, the shoes are very comfortable.
C. Yes, they sell many beautiful clothes.
D. No, I have never been to that store.
boss.explain: 英文原句：Have the wrong shoes been returned to the store? 意思：送錯的鞋子已經退回商店了嗎？選項 (A)「是的，我妹妹昨天拿回去了」最適合。（現在完成式被動語態）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The missing parts have not been delivered yet.
options: A. I have missed the train this morning.
B. Maybe we should track the order online.
C. The delivery man is very polite.
D. All the parts are working fine.
boss.explain: 英文原句：The missing parts have not been delivered yet. 意思：缺少的零件還沒送達。選項 (B)「也許我們應該在網路上追蹤訂單」最適合。（現在完成式被動語態）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Have you been charged twice for the same dress?
options: A. I usually wear a dress to the party.
B. The battery needs to be charged.
C. Yes, I will call their customer service.
D. No, I bought two dresses instead.
boss.explain: 英文原句：Have you been charged twice for the same dress? 意思：同一件洋裝你被扣款兩次了嗎？選項 (C)「是的，我會打給他們的客服」最適合。（現在完成式被動語態）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Has the flat tire been changed by the mechanic?
options: A. I feel very tired after a long day.
B. Yes, the car is ready to go now.
C. The road is very flat and wide.
D. No, he hasn't checked the engine.
boss.explain: 英文原句：Has the flat tire been changed by the mechanic? 意思：爆胎的輪胎已經被技工換好了嗎？選項 (B)「是的，車子現在可以開了」最適合。（現在完成式被動語態）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Have you noticed any strange noise from the engine?
options: A. No, it sounds completely normal to me.
B. Yes, the music is a bit too loud.
C. I have not noticed the weather change.
D. The engine is quite new.
boss.explain: 英文原句：Have you noticed any strange noise from the engine? 意思：你有注意到引擎發出什麼奇怪的聲音嗎？選項 (A)「沒有，聽起來完全正常」最適合。（現在完成式）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Has her grade been talked about during the meeting?
options: A. Yes, the teacher said she has improved a lot.
B. No, I do not like to talk to strangers.
C. Yes, she graded all the papers last night.
D. The meeting room is on the second floor.
boss.explain: 英文原句：Has her grade been talked about during the meeting? 意思：在會議中談到她的成績了嗎？選項 (A)「有，老師說她進步了很多」最適合。（現在完成式被動語態）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Has the school schedule for next semester been released?
options: A. I have a very busy schedule today.
B. Yes, it was posted on the website yesterday.
C. The school is far from my house.
D. Next semester will begin in September.
boss.explain: 英文原句：Has the school schedule for next semester been released? 意思：下學期的學校行事曆發布了嗎？選項 (B)「是的，昨天發布在網站上了」最適合。（現在完成式被動語態）
